//: NOT a package — a MODULE-TYPE MARKER, the app/package.json pattern. Everything under nukernel/ui/ is a native browser ES module, but the repo root declares "type": "commonjs", and node resolves module type from the NEAREST package.json — so without this file test/unit/nukernel.test.js could not import ui/derive.js and its §31/§33 render-path checks would have to run on hand-copied mirrors (which is exactly how the mirror drifted). The browser never reads it; no build step consumes it; do not add dependencies here.
